syllabus.clause: drill-across queries that combine facts of different grains without fan-out

items.item: Dimension tables conform when attributes in separate tables share the same column names and domain contents
A conformed attribute used as the row header lets separate fact tables' results align on the same rows in a drill-across report — the essence of integration
Conformed dimensions are defined once with the business's governance representatives and reused across fact tables, for consistency and reduced development cost
Drilling across means separate queries against two or more fact tables with identical conformed row headers

items.item: The fan-out (step 6) and aggregate-first (step 7) demonstrations are both run against real, disclosed throwaway fact tables built for this topic, not a described hypothetical — the six-row fan-out and the correct aggregate-first totals are both executed, not asserted
